title: eDNA African freshwater metabarcoding pipeline: multi-marker Illumina eDNA metabarcoding workflow for African freshwater systems
description:
A modular, step-based Bash workflow for Illumina eDNA metabarcoding data from African freshwater systems, targeting COI, 12S rRNA, 16S rRNA and 18S rRNA. It concatenates lane-level reads, runs quality control (FastQC, MultiQC) and filtering (fastp), demultiplexes reads by marker (cutadapt), infers ASVs (QIIME2/DADA2) and clusters OTUs at 97% identity (VSEARCH), and assigns taxonomy with BLAST and TaxonKit. Each step can be run independently.

Developed at KU Leuven in African freshwater eDNA research with the Royal Museum for Central Africa.
